media.title: Alexis Granovsky — portrait
media.description: Portrait of Alexis Granovsky (1890–1937), theatre and film director; used to identify the director of Moscow Nights (Nuits Moscovites, 1934), for which Kaper wrote the score.
media.altText: Black-and-white portrait photograph of Alexis Granovsky.
